name: Titanium.UI.AttributedString
summary:
An attributed string proxy manages character strings and associated sets of attributes (for example,
font and foregroundcolor) that apply to individual characters or ranges of characters in the string.
description:
The AttributedString proxy is created with the [Titanium.UI.createAttributedString](api:Titanium.UI#createAttributedString) method.

The `text` property must be set initially in the constructor when creating an attributed string.
The [attributes](api:Titanium.UI.AttributedString#attributes) can either be set in the constructor or after it has been created.

For examples of Attributed Strings, see the
[Attributed Strings guide](https://titaniumsdk.com/guide/Titanium_SDK/Titanium_SDK_How-tos/User_Interface_Deep_Dives/Attributed_Strings.html).

properties.name: attributes
properties.summary: An array of attributes to add.
properties.description:
Internally, this calls the [addAttribute](api:Titanium.UI.AttributedString#addAttribute)
method for each of the attributes passed in.

properties.name: text
properties.summary: The text applied to the attributed string.
properties.description: The `text` property must be set in the constructor and cannot be changed.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.summary: Adds an [attribute](api:Attribute) with the given name and value to the characters in the specified range.
